visualCharacteristics: Featured-article panel with a light grey background: large photo on the left, text on the right (eyebrow label, large heading, body copy, and a CTA button). Stacks vertically on mobile.
contentPattern: One row, two cells: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = eyebrow + heading + description + CTA link.
usage: Homepage 'Featured Article' section (Camping in Western Australia). Also reused for the magazine (/us/en/magazine) featured-article panel.
